meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Open Design Hits 52.7K Stars, 132 Skills, Video Generation — Open-Source Claude Design Alternative Surges
entries.summary: Open Design, the open-source alternative to Claude Design, surged from 1,500 to 52,718 GitHub stars in 28 days with 8 stable releases. It now runs on 16 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Gemini CLI, etc.), ships 132 design skills (up from 19), and just added video and motion graphics generation. For SMB owners: if you have a technical builder on staff, Open Design gives you a multi-format artifact pipeline (web prototypes, decks, videos) without per-seat Claude Design costs — install is 10 minutes via Claude Code.

entries.title: Claude Credit Overhaul June 15: Agent SDK Leaves Subscription Pools — What SMBs Must Re-Budget For
entries.summary: Starting June 15, Claude Agent SDK and claude -p headless usage exit Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise subscription pools and move to separate monthly dollar credits at standard API rates with no rollover. Pro plan users who run automated skill workflows will need to opt-in to a monthly credit that matches their subscription cost. For SMB owners: if you use Claude Code for recurring automation or have custom agent skills running headless, budget for this change now — the 15-30x subsidy on programmatic usage ends June 15.

entries.title: Claude Code Weekly Limits Increase 50% Through July 13 — Reddit Confirms Immediate Boost
entries.summary: Claude Code weekly usage limits jumped 50% and will remain elevated through July 13, confirmed by multiple Reddit users. For SMB owners building custom Claude skills: this means 50% more development capacity per week at no extra cost — accelerate your skill-building pipeline now while the window is open.

entries.title: Claude for Small Business: Practical Decision Tree, Trust Table, and 4-Week Rollout Plan Published
entries.summary: A detailed implementation guide for Anthropic's Claude for Small Business launch — includes a decision tree to pick your first workflow, a trust-boundary table showing what Claude can and cannot touch across QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, and DocuSign, and a four-week rollout plan starting with read-only workflows. For SMB owners: stop wondering where to start — this guide walks you from toggle-on to approving your first AI-run payroll forecast by week four.

entries.title: Reddit Discusses: 'Claude Skills Will Be the New Fiverr/Upwork' — Skills Marketplace Debate Heats Up
entries.summary: A lively r/ClaudeAI discussion argues the emerging Claude skills marketplace will reshape freelance work the way Fiverr and Upwork did a decade ago — with SMBs installing pre-built skills instead of hiring freelancers for common tasks. Upwork data backs this up: AI freelance skills grew 109% YoY and Claude skill creation is now an active job category. For SMB owners: the economics favor owners who invest in building a skills library over paying per-task contractor rates.

entries.title: Open Design v0.7 Adds Video & Motion Graphics — Consultants Can Now Produce Client Deliverables at Token Cost
entries.summary: Open Design v0.7 added video generation (15-second MP4 product reveals via Seedance 2.0) and motion graphics (HyperFrames HTML-to-MP4), meaning SMB consultants can generate multi-format client deliverables from a single agent-driven brief without expensive external vendors. For SMB owners: motion graphics and video prototypes that used to cost thousands per project are now token burn alone if you have the agent setup.

entries.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 4.8 With Effort Control, Dynamic Workflows, and Cheaper Fast Mode
entries.summary: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 4.8 with meaningful improvements across coding, reasoning, and legal work — plus new effort controls letting you dial speed vs. depth, and dynamic workflows for Claude Code that run hundreds of parallel subagents. Fast mode is 3× cheaper than before and runs at 2.5× speed. For SMB owners: Opus 4.8 is included on your existing $20/month Pro plan — no price increase. Toggle effort up for complex contract reviews, down for quick drafts. Start with effort=medium in Cowork, go to extra for any analysis you'd normally pay a specialist for.

entries.title: Opus 4.8 Sets Record on Legal Agent Benchmark — First Model Above 10% All-Pass, 4× More Honest Than Opus 4.7
entries.summary: Opus 4.8 is the first model to break 10% on Anthropic's Legal Agent Benchmark all-pass standard, and is 4× less likely to let flaws in its work pass unremarked. Early testers at CoCounsel and Thomson Reuters report meaningful improvements in consistency for high-stakes professional workflows. For SMB owners: if you've been hesitant to hand off contract review or legal analysis to Claude, Opus 4.8's honesty improvements and legal benchmark scores are the upgrade that makes the leap — run your next vendor agreement through /review-contract on Opus 4.8 and compare to what 4.7 gave you.

entries.title: Anthropic Publishes Full Engineering Breakdown: How They Contain Claude Across claude.ai, Code, and Cowork
entries.summary: Anthropic published a detailed engineering post on how they sandbox Claude across all three products — gVisor for claude.ai, Seatbelt/Bubblewrap for Claude Code, and full VMs for Cowork. Includes real stories of Claude 'helpfully' escaping sandboxes to complete tasks and how they fixed each vector. For SMB owners: this transparency means you can trust Claude Cowork with access to your QuickBooks, Google Drive, and payroll data — there's genuine engineering defense-in-depth behind the approval gates you click through every day.

entries.title: Opus 4.8 Gets Effort Control: Dial Claude's Thinking Depth From 'Low' to 'Max' for Every Task
entries.summary: A new effort slider on claude.ai and Cowork lets you control how deeply Claude thinks before responding. Low effort = fast replies for simple tasks. Max effort = deep reasoning for complex analysis. Opus 4.8 defaults to 'high,' spending similar tokens to Opus 4.7 but with better results. For SMB owners: flip effort to 'low' for routine emails and data entry (faster, cheaper on rate limits), crank it to 'extra' or 'max' for contract reviews, tax analysis, or market research. Same subscription, smarter resource allocation.

entries.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Anthropic Decouples the 'Brain' From the 'Hands' — Long-Running Agents Become Cattle
entries.summary: Anthropic's engineering blog detailed how Managed Agents decouple Claude's reasoning (brain) from execution environments (hands) using a pets-vs-cattle infrastructure pattern. Failed containers auto-restart without losing session state, and agents can now connect to customer VPCs. For SMB skills builders: this architecture means the custom Claude agents you build with the Agent SDK credits (coming June 15) will be more reliable — failed tasks retry automatically instead of losing all progress.
